thread:
aj: heads up — us-west shared-gpu pool saturated for ~18m, queue depth spiked and tenant 'searchlytics' is holding most slots. Seeing large tail latency and preemptions. Thoughts on short-term backpressure?

maria: yikes. are they running big batch evals or live traffic?

aj: looks like live traffic + occasional batch bursts. CPU sidecars are fine. GPU counts per-tenant jump from 4→40. infra-bot shows metric snippet.

infra-bot: US-WEST-GPU Pool metrics: util 98%, queue 650, 95p latency 1.8s, top tenant searchlytics 62% of in-flight.

kevin: for immediate relief can we apply per-tenant in-flight cap (soft) and start shaping? we did something similar for batch runner last quarter.

lina: agree. prefer "gentle failover": prioritize to slower q8 quant model or redirect to us-east with cross-region routing, not hard-kill. clients can accept a 2x latency for degraded mode.

maria: need cost guardrails — cross-region increases egress costs. propose policy: if routing -> check monthly spend threshold flag, otherwise cap + queued retry with jitter.

aj: here's a draft admission control patch: 
```
admission_control:
  tenant_limits:
    default_inflight: 8
    soft_burst: 16
    refill_rate: 1/s
  routing:
    on_soft_exceed: degrade_to: "quant-q8"; route_fallback: east-1; add_header: "x-inference-degraded: true"
```

kevin: quick question — how do we ensure fairness for low-volume tenants? token bucket alone still lets big spenders keep tokens. maybe weighted refill by historical fairness score.

lina: weighted refill + decay window (24h) should work. also emit per-tenant 'throttle' events to Sentry/Telemetry so Sales sees when customers hit it.

maria: rollout plan? prefer staged: canary small subset of hosts + night window, then fleet.

ops-squad: can we schedule a 30m patch window at 23:00 PST? we'll handle ops runbook.

aj: i'll open PR with config flags and telemetry hooks. will also add a feature flag to enable cross-region reroute. target canary at 23:00 PST.

kevin: add a kill-switch to revert routing quickly.

aj: yup. will include. thanks all :thumbsup: 

ops-squad: noted — we'll be on standby.

infra-bot: deploy-job queued: ad-control-canary -> 3 hosts in us-west. ETA 23:05 PST.

maria: follow-up — add billing owner cc on alert emails for cross-region route.

aj: added.

kevin: also add a metric: fraction of total in-flight per-tenant to console dashboard.

aj: added to tasklist.

lina: one more — test client behavior for 'x-inference-degraded' header so SDKs can surface to end users.

aj: good call, assigning to devex.
